notes: MLXUI-authored (RSI/DelegateOCRPromptBacklog.md OCP-3-1 prerequisite / AM-W, journal 2026-235). catflow-mlx has no PaddleOCR-VL manifest to port -- the model was evaluated during SPEC-Q131 curation and rejected there (loads but emits internal weight-parameter names under that project's pinned mlx_vlm), so this file is authored here the same way glm-ocr-4bit.json is. `engine` is `mlx-vlm` for parity with the other OCR manifests; MLXUI actually runs PaddleOCR-VL through the vendored PaddleOCRVL pipeline (SUP-1), not MLXVLM. `settings` is empty pending OCP-3-1, which adds the `mode` enum (ocr/table/formula/chart, positional) that PaddleOCR-VL's `promptSupport` already declares in Swift (journal 2026-229); OCP-3-5 then derives `PromptSupport.modes` from this file instead of the hardcoded list. resources.{disk_gb,ram_gb} are browser.json's downloadSizeGB / ramGB (the 1.5x-heuristic gate figures), not Python-measured numbers.
